payload.body: Slot 65 is green on 5391226b, the last test gate. The utilz suite but install_e2e.bats ran 252 ok on /bin/bash 3.2.57 (115.7 s) and 252 ok on bash 5.3.20 (100.0 s), with 0 not ok and nothing left running. Two corrections are in the END to gtools-vc. Second, two of the 252 are skips that this machine's tools force, on both bashes, in files the candidate leaves unchanged: parse_yaml() requires yq (yq installed) and utilz test runs without bats (bats installed). dc's kovacs 263 agrees: 252 plus install_e2e's 11. Every gate but hv's is met. On hv's word I land 0077 first, then 0079 after install_e2e.bats in the primary, booked. Each SHA goes to dc for verify-landed.sh.
